title: Spy Out the Land
text: Send out for yourself men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites.

title: One from Each Tribe
text: From each of their fathers’ tribes send one man who is a leader among them.

title: See What the Land Is Like
text: See what the land is like and whether its people are strong or weak, few or many.

title: Be Courageous
text: Be courageous and bring back some of the fruit of the land.

title: Up through the Negev
text: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron …

title: Hebron
text: It had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.

title: The Season of First Grapes
text: (It was the season for the first ripe grapes.)

title: A Single Cluster of Grapes
text: … they cut down a branch with a single cluster of grapes, which they carried on a pole between two men.

title: Pomegranates and Figs
text: They also took some pomegranates and figs.

title: The Valley of Eshcol
text: Because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut there, that place was called the Valley of Eshcol.

title: After Forty Days
text: After forty days the men returned from spying out the land …

title: Milk and Honey
text: We went into the land to which you sent us, and indeed, it is flowing with milk and honey.

title: Large and Fortified
text: Nevertheless, the people living in the land are strong, and the cities are large and fortified.

title: We Can Certainly Conquer It
text: We must go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly conquer it!

title: Like Grasshoppers
text: We seemed like grasshoppers in our own sight, and we must have seemed the same to them!

title: A Bad Report
text: So they gave the Israelites a bad report about the land that they had spied out …

title: The People Wept
text: Then the whole congregation lifted up their voices and cried out, and that night the people wept.

title: Back to Egypt?
text: Would it not be better for us to go back to Egypt?

title: An Exceedingly Good Land
text: The land we passed through and explored is an exceedingly good land.

title: Do Not Be Afraid
text: … do not be afraid of the people of the land, for they will be like bread for us. Their protection has been removed, and the LORD is with us. Do not be afraid of them!

title: They Threatened to Stone Them
text: But the whole congregation threatened to stone Joshua and Caleb.

title: I Have Pardoned Them
text: I have pardoned them as you requested,

title: A Different Spirit
text: But because My servant Caleb has a different spirit and has followed Me wholeheartedly …

title: Forty Years
text: In keeping with the forty days you spied out the land, you shall bear your guilt forty years …

title: Your Children Will Enjoy It
text: But I will bring your children, whom you said would become plunder, into the land you have rejected—and they will enjoy it.

title: One from Each Tribe
text: From each of their fathers’ tribes send one man who is a leader among them.

title: Our Wives and Children
text: Our wives and children will become plunder.

title: Fertile or Unproductive?
text: Is the soil fertile or unproductive? Are there trees in it or not?

title: The Descendants of Anak
text: We even saw the descendants of Anak there.

title: Older than Zoan
text: It had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.
